markdown:
Hello,

My name is Teresa and I manage the front desk at Lakeview Dental. We have been using your scheduling software for two years and its been great, but we have recently noticed that the reminder texts are going out a day late.

Is this a known issue? We have 600 patients in the system so it's a big problem for us.

Thank you,
Teresa Gomez
